text.c98c7a1e85cb5c8c596f: Years1–5 are rolling annual periods ending September 2027–2031, from the current TTM. They are not calendarFY2027growth overcalendarFY2026. The base combines leading-node/HPC and packaging growth with moderation in smartphone and mature nodes. Revenue reaches TWD11.605tr in year5 and18.080tr in year15,3.66times the starting scale. The bull reaches29.440tr, requiring sustained high-value mix, capacity and industry demand far beyond today's level. The bear reaches9.489tr after a year2contraction, with lower utilization and economics. It is a continuing-business bear, not a probabilistic Taiwan asset-loss scenario.
text.e2ae60bdda9ce029c249: Base early marginal sales/capital ratios are1.30,1.25,1.20,1.15 and1.10x. Positive sales increments divided by those ratios produce net reinvestment; the ratio later fades to0.489x, consistent with18% terminalROIC and36.8% after-tax margin. D&A rises from17% toward20% of sales and NWC is modeled at5% as audit assumptions, not asserted historical ratios. Implied capex = D&A + net reinvestment − changeNWC; do not subtract that capex again. It is an approximate consistency check, not a reconstruction of gross management capex after grant/accrual/FX timing. The bear contraction year retains an8%-of-revenue net-reinvestment floor instead of fictitious liquidation.
text.a899581651c1e15628af: SBC remains an expense, with a0.05%-of-revenue reserve slightly above2025 reported intensity. Low historical SBC does not remove award/share-count checks. Ordinary grant economics are embedded in net capital efficiency; there is no additional free grant asset. Overseas ramp costs are embedded in declining margins; do not subtract3–4points again.
text.72b91730d11a71c70075: Fifteen years permits several technology and overseas-fab generations before mature economics. Ten years would compress an unusually durable but fading ecosystem advantage; twenty would prolong a speculative high-growth tail. After year5 the base growth schedule is8%,7%,6%,5%,4.5%,4%,3.5%,3%,2.5%,2%, then perpetual2%. Mature EBIT46% is below current~58% TTM and reflects mix/utilization/foreign-cost normalization.

text.d19e55656208061a906a: C.C. Wei has been CEO sinceJune 2018 and chairman sinceJune 2024, following a co-CEO role fromNovember 2013. text.5a5fb635fbd3d35ab728: Demand forecasting (medium-high short term, medium long term confidence):
text.2dafcfe1623007638cbe: Strong recent quarterly execution and conservative ranges; multiyear demand remains a judgment. Evidence/outcome: Eight consecutive reported quarters meet or exceed original USD revenue range; five above, three within. Management checks customers and their customers and now reports checking data-center build-outs/power. Supports a strong near-term starting path, not automatic 25% growth from today. Counterevidence: Raising 2026 capex from $52-56bn to $60-64bn demonstrates forecast revision rather than perfect foresight. 2023 revenue declined in the historical record. Demand signals may overlap across customers; signed product plans are not end-user monetization.
text.7ab950e151cc5dda919b: Product delivery (high recent, medium forward confidence):
text.ac88eb8a612c73a5681e: Leading-node ramp has revenue and yield evidence; future A14 remains a roadmap. Evidence/outcome: N2 entered high-volume production Q4 2025 and accounts for 8% of Q3 2026 wafer revenue. 7nm-and-below is 79% of wafer revenue. Demonstrated ability to monetize leading nodes, enabling measured persistence in margin/returns. Counterevidence: A14 2027 risk/2028 volume-production objectives are not realized. Node mix and competitor yield improvements can change advantage quickly.
text.a7d6aec04726d4252e1d: Operational ramp competence is visible, with larger overseas execution burden ahead. Evidence/outcome: Arizona first fab high-volume production confirmed in Q4 2024. N2 now ramps across Hsinchu/Kaohsiung; capacity expected to more than double in 2027. Capacity delivers current shipments, but almost 20 fab projects make forward workload unusually large. Counterevidence: Overseas dilution increases as several fabs open. Tool availability, power/water, skills, labor and subsidies can delay economically usable output.
text.12e194717a694b6ac83e: Better utilization and productivity repeatedly beat margin guidance; FX and mix must be separated from skill. Evidence/outcome: Q3 2026 58.7% EBIT margin versus 56-58% guide; Q2 60.3% versus 56.5-58.5%. Q3 gross margin fell 1.3 points as N2 ramp diluted margins, as directionally anticipated. Justifies above-industry mature economics, with explicit fade for foreign-fab cost. Counterevidence: 2025Q3 favorable currency versus guide helped margins; not all beat is cost control. N2 and overseas costs can outlast productivity gains.
text.28cd9400a1e337221ed7: Capital allocation (medium-high historical, medium forecast confidence):
text.54beb0fa4d8a51588475: Investment has supported profitable growth, but new capex is a demanding long-duration commitment. Evidence/outcome: FY2025 operating cash flow TWD2.275tr versus capex TWD1.272tr. Current balance sheet has substantial cash/investments; regular dividends. Model requires reinvestment and returns decay; no valuation premium solely for leadership reputation. Counterevidence: Higher construction/tool cost per wafer and foreign fab economics may depress future incremental returns. Cash/ROE is not ROIC; refundable customer receipts and NCI/leases affect claims. Taiwan continuity risk is outside management control.

text.f99df5d2c69be1ffb98b: Watch leading-node utilization versus added capacity; N2/A14 qualification and yields; CoWoS/packaging throughput; customer concentration; overseas fab cost and subsidies; supplier/tool/energy inflation; export restrictions; and power/water continuity. More wafer revenue per unit can reflect value creation but also creates exposure to high-end demand concentration. Multi-quarter revenue shortfalls, slower node qualification or foreign-margin dilution beyond the modeled path invalidate the base. Customer capex announcements and overlapping forecasts do not prove ultimate demand or monetization.
text.304234c3c550b44edc89: Taiwan geopolitical disruption, earthquakes and operational concentration deserve explicit stress scenarios. A few WACC points cannot faithfully encode total interruption or asset loss. The annual filing recorded earthquake-related losses in 2024/2025, demonstrating nonzero physical disruption risk; the proposed bear assumes continued operation.
